description: This header file declares functions related to the Dynamo evaluation frame in PyTorch, including custom eval frame handling, code execution strategy, recursion limit management, and related includes.

methods.name: dynamo__custom_eval_frame
methods.description: Handles the custom evaluation frame in Dynamo, evaluating a frame with a callback.

methods.name: dynamo_set_code_exec_strategy
methods.description: Sets the code execution strategy for Dynamo.

methods.name: dynamo_skip_code_recursive
methods.description: Skips recursive code execution in Dynamo.

methods.name: dynamo_set_c_recursion_limit
methods.description: Sets the recursion limit for Dynamo's C code.

methods.name: dynamo_get_c_recursion_limit
methods.description: Retrieves the current recursion limit setting for Dynamo's C code.
